title: Orrik the Wheelwright
dek: A resident whose suspicion of adventurers coexists with concrete proposals for changing how Pristinia is governed.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
A skeptical resident

Orrik objects to intrusive magic and to adventurers treating the town as theirs. Vizsla reminds him of their past help, so the argument preserves disagreement within the civilian community rather than giving residents a single voice.

Reform and commitment

He presents his group’s proposals for lower candidacy ages, limited terms and excluding adventurers from Elder elections. He later approves the idea of property ownership as evidence that newcomers have invested in the town. These are positions in a debate, not a substitute for the recorded vote outcomes.

Keeping the institution recognizable

At a later assembly he asks that the proposed document retain the familiar name Pristinia Elders instead of renaming the body. He also calls Katherine an Elder. The statement preserves his understanding at that meeting, while the larger history still requires attention to the sequence of decisions.

Recorded scenes

  • Opposition to intrusive magic
  • His group’s institutional proposals
  • Property as local commitment
  • Retaining the name Pristinia Elders
  • Katherine identified as an Elder
